text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis in the opening and final paragraph","quality":"argumentative clarity","description":"The essay states a position early and returns to it consistently so the reader always knows the writer's stance."},{"evidence":"“although there are some setbacks... there are many more advantages”","quality":"balanced reasoning","description":"The essay acknowledges counterarguments and then explains why its own side still wins."},{"evidence":"paragraph on safety and liability, then paragraph on benefits","quality":"organization","description":"The essay develops its ideas in a more logical sequence with distinct points in separate body paragraphs."},{"evidence":"driver seats that vibrate, flashing lights, cameras, entertainment systems","quality":"development","description":"The essay supports claims with several concrete details instead of relying on brief general statements."},{"evidence":"“could fundamentally change the world,” “worth the wait,” “extraordinary new way of transportation”","quality":"commentary","description":"The essay more often explains why the evidence matters, not just what the source says."}]}
